title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Company:** Envision Next LLP  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Position:** Project Coordinator  
**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time  
**Location:** Turbhe, Navi Mumbai  
**Reporting To:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 Year  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or B.Arch.

**About the Role**

Envision Next LLP is looking for a technically sound and highly organized **Project Coordinator** to support the project team in planning, coordination, documentation, tendering and execution-related activities across real estate projects.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of construction drawings, project execution stages, project planning and phasing, basic tendering processes, material specifications and project documentation.

The role requires strong coordination and follow-up abilities, attention to detail, professional communication and the ability to work effectively with architects, consultants, contractors, internal teams and other project stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Coordination**

* Coordinate day-to-day project-related activities between internal teams, consultants, architects, contractors and other stakeholders.
* Track project deliverables, pending activities and important timelines.
* Follow up with respective stakeholders to ensure timely submission of drawings, documents and required information.
* Maintain action-point trackers and ensure closure of pending items.
* Support the Project Manager/COO in coordinating multiple project activities simultaneously.

**2. Drawing & Technical Coordination**

* Read, understand and coordinate various types of construction drawings.
* Review basic architectural, structural, MEP and other project drawings.
* Coordinate drawing submissions, revisions and circulation among relevant stakeholders.
* Identify basic discrepancies, missing information or coordination issues in drawings and bring them to the attention of the concerned team.
* Maintain proper records of drawing revisions and issued drawings.
* Assist in basic drawing editing and modifications using AutoCAD.

**3. Project Planning & Execution**

* Understand different stages of real estate project execution.
* Assist in preparation and monitoring of project plans and execution schedules.
* Understand project phasing and sequence of activities.
* Track key project milestones and deliverables.
* Assist in monitoring progress against planned timelines.
* Coordinate information required for various stages of project execution.
* Support the project team in identifying delays, pending decisions and coordination requirements.

**4. Tendering & Procurement Support**

* Understand the basic process of project tendering.
* Assist in preparation, compilation and coordination of tender-related documents.
* Understand basic BOQ, scope of work, specifications and tender requirements.
* Coordinate with consultants and contractors for tender-related information.
* Assist in collecting and organizing technical and commercial information required for tendering.
* Support the team during tender comparison, clarification and coordination activities.

**5. Material & Specification Understanding**

* Develop a basic understanding of construction materials and their applications.
* Understand basic material specifications mentioned in project documents and drawings.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders regarding material-related technical information.
* Assist in maintaining material specifications, technical data and related project documentation.

**6. Project Documentation**

* Maintain systematic project documentation and records.
* Prepare and maintain project trackers, registers and status reports.
* Prepare Minutes of Meetings (MOM) and track action points.
* Maintain records of drawings, submissions, approvals, correspondence and project communications.
* Assist in preparation of project reports and management updates.
* Ensure documents are properly organized and easily accessible for project review and reference.

**7. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate effectively with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors and internal teams.
* Follow up professionally with stakeholders for pending submissions and deliverables.
* Participate in project meetings and discussions.
* Assist in resolving routine coordination issues between stakeholders.
* Demonstrate good negotiation and communication skills while coordinating project requirements.
* Escalate critical issues to the reporting manager/COO in a timely manner.

**8. Project & Site Visits**

* Undertake occasional site visits as required for project understanding, coordination and analysis.
* Observe project progress and understand actual site conditions in relation to drawings and planned activities.
* Assist in collecting site-related information required for project reporting and coordination.
* Coordinate with site teams to obtain updates, photographs, drawings and other relevant information.

**9. Management Reporting & Presentations**

* Prepare project status reports and MIS as required.
* Prepare professional PowerPoint presentations for internal and management reviews.
* Assist in preparing project summaries, progress updates and analytical presentations.
* Maintain Excel-based project trackers and databases.
* Present project information clearly and accurately to senior management when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should possess:

* Excellent understanding of construction and architectural drawings.
* Knowledge of architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
* Basic AutoCAD knowledge and ability to make minor drawing edits.
* Understanding of project execution stages.
* Basic understanding of project planning and project phasing.
* Basic knowledge of tendering and BOQ-related processes.
* Basic understanding of construction materials and specifications.
* Good understanding of project documentation.
* Good MS Office skills, particularly:
* MS Excel
* MS Word
* MS PowerPoint
* Ability to prepare professional presentations and reports.
* Ability to maintain trackers, registers and project records.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up ability.
* Good negotiation skills.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Proactive approach to identifying and following up on pending activities.
* Ability to work under deadlines.
* Professional approach while dealing with stakeholders.
* Good analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Ability to work independently as well as as part of a team.

**Eligibility Criteria**

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering **or**
* B.Arch.

**Experience**

* Minimum **1 year of relevant experience** in project coordination, real estate, construction, architecture, project management consultancy or a related field.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should have practical exposure to:

* Real estate/construction projects.
* Reading and coordinating drawings.
* Project planning and execution.
* Tender documentation.
* Project documentation and reporting.
* Consultant/contractor coordination.
* MS Office and PowerPoint.
* Basic AutoCAD and drawing editing.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a **responsible, technically oriented and proactive professional** who can bridge the gap between project planning, technical documentation and stakeholder coordination.

The candidate should not only be comfortable working with documents and Excel sheets but should also be able to **understand drawings, follow project execution, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and independently follow up on assigned responsibilities.**

The role offers an opportunity to gain broad exposure to **real estate project planning, tendering, execution, documentation and project management.**

**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. We help our clients buy, build, occupy, manage and invest in a variety of assets including industrial, commercial, retail, residential and hotel real estate.

Our PDS division in Mumbai manages a diverse portfolio of projects including commercial office fit-outs, base building developments, retail spaces, data centers, logistics facilities, and industrial projects. We provide comprehensive services from project conception through completion, ensuring delivery excellence for leading multinational and domestic clients.
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced Assistant Project Lead to join our PDS team in Mumbai. This role serves as a critical bridge between project execution teams and senior project leadership, requiring an individual who can independently manage project portfolios while supporting strategic client relationships. The Assistant Project Lead will oversee multiple concurrent projects, mentor junior team members, and ensure delivery of projects that meet JLL's standards of excellence in quality, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Project Leadership & Management The Assistant Project Lead will independently manage a portfolio of medium to large-scale construction and fit-out projects valued between INR 5 crore to INR 50 crore. This includes overseeing all phases from project initiation through closeout, ensuring seamless coordination across design, procurement, construction, and commissioning stages. Client Relationship Management Building and maintaining strong client relationships is essential. Understanding client business objectives and translating them into effective project delivery strategies will be key to success in this role.

This includes delegating tasks effectively, monitoring team workload, and creating a collaborative environment that encourages learning and accountability. Building team capability while maintaining high performance standards is a critical responsibility.
  
Budget & Cost Management Comprehensive financial management of projects is required, including developing detailed project budgets, tracking costs against approved budgets, managing cash flow projections, reviewing and approving contractor payment applications, and preparing financial reports for clients and senior management. You will negotiate change orders, identify cost-saving opportunities, and ensure projects are delivered within approved financial parameters.
  
Schedule Management & Planning You will develop and maintain detailed project schedules using MS Project or Primavera, identifying critical path activities, monitoring progress against milestones, and implementing recovery plans when delays occur. Coordinating with contractors and consultants to optimize construction sequencing and minimize schedule impacts is essential. Regular schedule updates and forecasting project completion dates accurately will be required.
  
Contract Administration & Procurement Managing contractor and consultant agreements throughout project lifecycles is a key responsibility. This includes contract negotiation support, administering change orders, resolving commercial disputes, ensuring contractual compliance, and managing claims. You will oversee procurement processes including tender preparation, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award recommendations.
  
Quality Assurance & Technical Oversight Ensuring projects meet JLL's quality standards and client specifications requires rigorous oversight. You will establish quality control procedures, conduct regular site inspections, review contractor workmanship, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage defect rectification processes. Risk Management & Problem Solving Proactive identification and mitigation of project risks across schedule, cost, quality, and safety dimensions is essential. You will develop risk registers, implement mitigation strategies, and resolve complex technical and commercial challenges that arise during project execution. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities will be critical to navigating project complexities successfully.

You will ensure strict compliance with JLL's HSE policies, conduct safety audits, chair safety meetings, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions. Creating safe working environments and holding contractors accountable to HSE standards protects both personnel and the organization.
  
Reporting & Governance Preparing comprehensive project reports for internal leadership and external clients is required. This includes weekly progress reports, monthly executive summaries, financial dashboards, risk reports, and project closeout documentation. You will ensure projects adhere to JLL's governance frameworks and maintain complete project records throughout delivery.
  
Stakeholder Coordination Coordinating with diverse stakeholders including clients, contractors, consultants, architects, MEP engineers, local authorities, and internal JLL teams requires excellent communication and relationship management skills. You will facilitate collaboration, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment across all parties toward common project objectives.
  
Business Development Support Supporting business development initiatives by participating in client presentations, preparing project proposals, contributing to RFP responses, and leveraging existing client relationships for portfolio expansion opportunities will contribute to team growth objectives.
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Post-graduate qualification (M.Tech, MBA) in Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is advantageous.
  
  
**Technical Expertise:**  
Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with ability to review and mark up technical drawings
  
Strong working knowledge of MS Project or Primavera P6 for schedule development and management
  
Comprehensive understanding of construction methodologies, building systems (structural, MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection), and finishing works
  
Familiarity with building codes including NBC, local municipal regulations, fire safety norms, and environmental compliance requirements
  
Advanced MS Office skills, particularly Excel for financial modeling and budget tracking
  
  
**Core Competencies:**  
Strong leadership abilities with proven team management experience
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; additional regional languages advantageous
  
Outstanding organizational and multitasking capabilities to manage concurrent projects effectively
  
Strategic thinking combined with meticulous attention to operational details
  
Client-focused approach with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills
  
Decisive decision-making abilities under pressure
  
Commercial acumen with strong financial and business awareness
  
Problem-solving mindset with analytical and critical thinking abilities
  
High integrity and professionalism in all interactions
  
  
**Other Requirements:**  
Willingness to travel extensively across Mumbai, MMR region.
  
Flexibility to work extended hours and weekends during critical project phases

Career Progression
  
The Assistant Project Lead role provides a clear pathway to Project Lead and Senior Project Manager positions within JLL's PDS division. High performers will have opportunities to lead larger, more complex projects, expand client portfolios, and eventually progress to senior leadership roles overseeing regional operations or specialized practice areas. JLL supports career growth through continuous learning, internal mobility programs, and leadership development initiatives.

The candidate must have strong technical knowledge of interior fit-outs, modular and custom furniture manufacturing, project scheduling, vendor management, site coordination, cost control, and client relationship management.

**A. Project Planning and Execution**

* Manage end-to-end execution of turnkey interior and furniture projects, including corporate offices, educational institutions, government projects, and commercial establishments.

* Prepare detailed project schedules, manpower plans, material procurement plans, and installation timelines.
* Monitor project progress against milestones and ensure timely completion.
* Identify potential project risks, execution challenges, and delays, and implement corrective measures.

**B. Furniture Manufacturing and Factory Coordination**

* Coordinate with the factory, design, purchase, and production teams for the timely manufacturing and dispatch of furniture.
* Ensure production follows approved drawings, material specifications, dimensions, finishes, and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules, material availability, wastage, and manufacturing quality.
* Coordinate prototype development, sample approvals, and mock-ups wherever required.
* Ensure timely delivery of furniture and materials to project sites in accordance with the installation schedule.

**C. Site Execution and Installation**

* Supervise site execution activities, including interior fit-outs, furniture installation, carpentry, civil modifications, electrical coordination, and other allied works within the project scope.
* Coordinate with Project Site In-charges, Site Supervisors, installation teams, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Ensure site readiness before furniture installation and coordinate the sequence of work.
* Monitor daily progress, manpower deployment, material consumption, and work quality.
* Resolve technical issues, drawing discrepancies, site constraints, and execution bottlenecks.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements and applicable project guidelines.

**D. Design and Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Design Department for drawings, technical details, shop drawings, BOQs, and revisions.
* Ensure all work is executed strictly as per approved drawings and client specifications.
* Obtain necessary client and consultant approvals before proceeding with changes or additional work.
* Identify design-related execution challenges and coordinate timely technical resolutions.
* Ensure proper documentation and communication of drawing revisions to the factory and site teams.

**E. Budgeting and Cost Control**

* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and BOQs.
* Control material wastage, labour costs, transportation expenses, subcontracting costs, and rework.
* Track project variations, extra items, and additional scope of work.
* Coordinate with the Purchase and Accounts Departments for procurement planning, vendor payments, billing, and cost reconciliation.
* Maintain project cost records and prepare cost-to-complete estimates.
* Escalate cost overruns and recommend corrective measures.

**F. Client and Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary coordination point for clients, architects, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
* Attend project review meetings and provide regular progress updates.
* Understand client requirements and ensure deliverables meet agreed specifications.
* Manage client feedback, complaints, snags, and project-related escalations.
* Obtain approvals, inspection clearances, completion certificates, and handover sign-offs as applicable.
* Maintain professional relationships to support client satisfaction and repeat business.

**G. Vendor and Subcontractor Management**

* Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and subcontractors for timely material supply and execution.
* Monitor vendor performance, workmanship, quality, and adherence to schedules.
* Verify completed work and material deliveries against approved specifications and contractual requirements.
* Ensure proper coordination between multiple agencies working at the project site.

**H. Quality Control, Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure quality checks at factory production, material receipt, site installation, and final handover stages.
* Conduct periodic site inspections and monitor compliance with approved specifications.
* Ensure appropriate site safety practices and housekeeping.
* Maintain inspection reports, quality checklists, snag lists, and corrective action records.
* Minimize defects, rework, material damage, and customer complaints.

**I. Documentation and Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain project schedules, daily/weekly progress reports, and project review reports.
* Maintain records of BOQs, approved drawings, material submittals, purchase requirements, work orders, and variation approvals.
* Monitor project milestones, billing status, material dispatches, and pending client approvals.
* Submit regular project status reports to the reporting authority.
* Ensure proper documentation of project completion, handover, and outstanding issues.

**J. Project Closure and After-Sales Coordination**

* Ensure completion of snag rectification and pending works before final handover.
* Coordinate final inspections, client sign-offs, and handover documentation.
* Support final measurement, billing, reconciliation, and closure of project accounts.
* Coordinate with the After-Sales team for warranty issues, defects, and post-handover service requirements.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Furniture Technology, or a related discipline.
* Additional qualifications in Project Management will be an advantage.

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in turnkey interior projects, commercial fit-outs, and/or furniture manufacturing and installation.
* Proven experience managing projects from planning to final handover.
* Strong understanding of modular and custom furniture, joinery, materials, hardware, finishes, and installation techniques.
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings, furniture layouts, shop drawings, BOQs, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of project scheduling, estimation, costing, billing, and budget monitoring.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Project, AutoCAD drawings, and project reporting tools.
* Experience coordinating factory production, procurement, vendors, subcontractors, and site execution teams.
* Experience handling multiple projects simultaneously will be an advantage.

**5. Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong project planning and execution capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, team management, and coordination skills.
* Effective communication, negotiation, and client-handling abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines, budgets, and competing priorities.

* Ability to work under pressure and travel to project sites as required.
* Proactive approach towards risk management and timely escalation of issues.

* **Cost Control:** Adherence to approved project budgets and minimization of cost overruns.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and strategic **Chief Project Officer (CPO)** to provide overall leadership and governance for the Company's real estate project portfolio.

The CPO will be responsible for ensuring that all projects are delivered **within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, specifications and regulatory requirements**. The role will oversee project planning, design coordination, approvals, procurement, construction, contracts, cost control, project monitoring and handover.

The CPO will work closely with the **MD/Directors, Design \& Planning, Projects, Contracts, Purchase, Accounts \& Finance, Legal, Liaisoning, Sales and CRM teams** to ensure seamless project execution and achievement of business objectives.

* Provide strategic leadership for all ongoing and upcoming real estate projects.
* Establish project execution strategy, milestones and delivery plans.
* Monitor overall portfolio performance and identify critical risks.
* Ensure alignment of project execution with the Company's business strategy.
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Project Heads and senior management.

2\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Oversee the complete project lifecycle from conceptualization to possession/handover.
* Review master schedules, construction programs and project milestones.
* Ensure timely commencement and completion of major project activities.
* Monitor progress against approved project schedules.

* Ensure adherence to construction schedules and quality standards.

5\. Cost Control \& Project Budget

* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets.
* Monitor project cost against approved estimates and budgets.
* Review major variations, deviations and additional costs.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Coordinate with Accounts, Purchase and Commercial teams on project expenditure.
* Monitor project profitability and financial performance.

6\. Contracts \& Procurement

* Work closely with Contracts and Purchase teams for timely appointment of contractors and vendors.
* Review major contracts, work orders and commercial terms.
* Monitor contractor performance and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely procurement of critical materials and services.

7\. Regulatory Approvals \& Liaisoning

* Coordinate with the Liaisoning and Legal teams to ensure timely statutory approvals.

* Establish and monitor project quality standards.

* Ensure proper testing, inspections and documentation.

* Critical milestones
* Contractor performance
* Approval status
* Procurement status
* Quality issues
* Risk register
* Provide accurate forecasts for project completion.

* Lead and mentor Project Managers, Construction Heads, Engineers and project teams.
* Define responsibilities, authority levels and performance expectations.
* Build a high\-performance project management culture.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews of project leadership teams.
* Develop SOPs and standardized project execution processes.

* Coordinate with CRM, Sales, Legal and Projects teams for possession readiness.

* Monitor snagging and defect rectification.
* Ensure proper project closure and post\-project review.
